description: Research Experience for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2021: Uncertainty Analysis of Seismic Soil Liquefaction using quoFEM is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Sanjay Govindjee, University of California Berkeley (berkeley.edu). This project provides an in-depth study into an uncertainty analysis performed in the quoFEM application (developed at the UC Berkeley SimCenter) on a sample of Ottawa F65 sand. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-ykmy-2j81. Keywords: UC Berkeley SimCenter, Uncertainty Analysis, Sensitivity Analysis, Bayesian Calibration, Forward Propagation, quoFEM. Published 2021-08-14. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
